highlights: Result Update 05th November, 2026 HOLD Target Price 660 Bata India Ltd Retail 1 Growth Recovery Continues; Maintain HOLD Est.

Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – BEAT; EBITDA – MISS; PAT – MISS Changes in Estimates post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: 0%/0%; EBITDA: -1%/-1%; PAT: -4%/-3% Recommendation Rationale • Gradual Revenue Recovery: Bata India reported 7.5% YoY revenue growth to Rs 862 Cr in Q2FY27, driven by a 5–6% increase in ASP and marginal volume growth.

Despite the festive calendar shift from Q2 to Q3, footfalls remained positive, while Bata and Hush Puppies continued to witness healthy consumer traction. • Gross Margin Stability Offset by Higher Operating Costs: Gross margin improved marginally by 7bps YoY; however, EBITDA margin declined 140bps to 16.7%, impacted by an unfavourable channel mix and higher operating costs.
The increasing contribution from distribution, e-commerce and franchise channels diluted the overall gross margin, although these businesses remained individually profitable.

On the cost front, other expenses and employee costs increased 13% and 9% YoY, respectively, further weighing on profitability. • Channel Growth & Expansion: The company plans to drive growth through franchise-led expansion, while selectively adding COCO stores, with double-digit store additions targeted over the next year.

Current Valuation: 33x Sep’28E EPS (Earlier Valuation: 38x Jun’28E EPS ) Current TP: Rs 660/share (Earlier TP: Rs 755/share) Recommendation: With a 4% upside from the CMP, we maintain our HOLD rating on the stock.
watch: However, the channel operates at lower ASPs, reflecting its volume-led nature. • Demand Outlook: Q2 growth remained largely ASP-led, with volume growth yet to gain traction.
Sector Outlook: Cautious Company Outlook & Guidance: While early signs of demand recovery are visible, the sustainability of the turnaround remains to be established.
